name: POST /api/analytics/builds/:build_id/export — export dataset to warehouse/object store
description: Exports an already-materialized dataset build to the warehouse / object store, optionally targeting a named destination via body.target (omitting it uses the configured default). Edge cases: an unknown build_id or a build owned by another tenant returns 404; the body is entirely optional; re-exporting the same build is allowed and simply overwrites/re-emits the artifact; large builds and object-store failures surface as 500.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
the verified JWT carries no tenant_id claim
build_id does not exist or belongs to a different tenant
the service/DB call throws (bad asset/sensor reference, ClickHouse or Postgres failure)

testCases.name: Export a built dataset to the warehouse
